title: ClaudeHarness Adapter Implementation Test Cases
description: Comprehensive test suite for Claude harness adapter implementation, covering config validation, subprocess invocation, NDJSON parsing, telemetry events, and SkillActivity integration

implementation_summary.notes: Most test cases are implemented. Implicit tests verify functionality via code paths without explicit test functions. helpers-003 tests string-to-int coercion, which current implementation intentionally rejects (returns None for non-int types). All 474 unit tests passing.

test_implementation_notes.mocking_strategy: Use pytest-mock and unittest.mock for subprocess, logging, and file operations. Mock get_activity_artifact_dir() and activity_log_context() to test both artifact and temporary paths without creating real files.
test_implementation_notes.test_structure: Follow pytest conventions: test_<module>_<function>_<scenario>.py for unit tests; tests/ directory mirrors src/ structure
test_implementation_notes.execution_order: Implement CRITICAL tests first (red phase), then HIGH priority (green phase), then remaining
test_implementation_notes.assertion_style: Use descriptive assertion messages; verify both success path and failure modes
test_implementation_notes.file_locations: Place tests in src/common/tests/ for common module tests (config, harness, usage parsing); integration tests in src/orchestrator/tests/
